page: Microsoft Azure M128lds_v4 is a memory-optimized instance built on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor and powered by an x86_64 Intel processor. The virtual machine delivers 128 dedicated vCPUs alongside 1944.0 GB of system memory, yielding an allocation of approximately 15.19 GB of RAM per vCPU. Storage capabilities include 4724 GB of direct-attached NVMe SSD space with support for Premium Storage. The instance does not include any GPU accelerators or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Hardware architecture emphasizes extreme memory capacity alongside high local throughput. The dedicated vCPU topology prevents host-level resource contention, ensuring consistent compute capability under saturated multi-threaded conditions. Furthermore, the integrated 4724 GB NVMe SSD array acts as low-latency scratch space or fast swap space to augment storage operations, offsetting potential remote disk bottlenecks during heavy read and write phases.

In qualitative terms, the M128lds_v4 provides high resource density per instance, maximizing efficiency for organizations consolidating sprawling multi-node workloads onto a single host. However, the absence of hardware accelerators rules it out for machine learning model acceleration, and setups requiring standard memory footprints may find the 15:1 RAM-to-vCPU ratio inefficient. The hardware profile is optimal for large-scale relational databases, enterprise in-memory engines such as SAP HANA, massive analytics caches, and heavy transactional ETL operations.
description: Microsoft Azure M128lds_v4 is an enterprise memory-optimized virtual machine operating on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. Powered by an x86_64 Intel processor, it features 128 dedicated vCPUs and 1944.0 GB of system memory, establishing a generous density of 15.19 GB of RAM per vCPU. The hardware setup includes 4724 GB of integrated local NVMe SSD storage alongside Premium Storage capability, while containing zero GPUs. The high memory ratio and dedicated CPU allocation make the platform effective for consolidating massive memory footprints into a single virtual server without multitenant CPU contention. The bundled NVMe storage supplies high-throughput, low-latency temporary capacity, compensating for cloud storage network limits. Consequently, the M128lds_v4 is engineered specifically for large in-memory database engines, enterprise analytics, transactional data warehousing, and demanding transactional ETL workloads.
